# About Us

Biolaunchpad is where healthcare professionals turn bright ideas into real-world innovations. In a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape, medical professionals are the ones who see the problems and dream up solutions. We bridge the gap between concept and creation, providing the tools, expertise, and support to transform your idea into a product that changes lives. While our platform primarily focuses on ideas from healthcare professionals, we welcome applications from individuals in any field and with any educational background. Feel free to share your innovative ideas with us.

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/676c019ab0a3e9b90d821e91_About%20Us.png)

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/673c6efedb310838b2e12a74_Vector.svg)

##### Our Mission

We are leveraging physician-led innovation to bring breakthrough HealthTech solutions to life, partnering with them to address real-world challenges and revolutionize healthcare.

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/673c6efefe3f45d754844e97_Group.svg)

##### What We Do

We don’t incubate ideas—we co-create. If your idea has potential, we partner with you to develop it into a market-ready product, offering the resources, expertise, and hands-on support needed to bring it to life.

## What Drives Us

Our mission began with a deeply personal challenge. [Ninad Saraf](https://linkedin.com/in/ninad-saraf-6a73a079), our founder, left his practice to dive into the world of robotics rehabilitation, determined to address the pressing issues in rehabilitation technology. But as he delved deeper, he discovered a much larger problem—a glaring gap in the MedTech development ecosystem itself.

Ninad's journey through various agencies and consultants was riddled with hurdles. Despite promises and payments, the results were often disappointing or non-existent. The system lacked transparency, professionalism, and quality. Some agencies were even outright fraudulent, lacking expertise or the ability to deliver. It became clear that the MedTech development landscape, particularly in hardware development, was a complex and challenging maze to navigate.

Ninad saw a deeper issue beyond transparency: India’s lack of a robust hardware development ecosystem. Resources were fragmented, mentorship scarce, and talent hard to find. Securing funding for hardware projects was an uphill battle in an industry primarily focused on software solutions. This led to a stark underfunding and neglect of crucial HardTech innovations.

Healthcare professionals, while possessing deep insights and expertise, often struggle to translate medical problems into technological solutions. They excel at identifying issues but lack exposure to technology development. Many, despite their passion for innovation, cannot fully commit to product development due to their demanding medical practice. They require a trusted partner to bridge this gap, transforming their ideas into reality while they continue their vital healthcare work.

At Biolaunchpad, we aim to change all of this. We’ve built a vertically integrated platform that takes on the complexities—be it legalities, hardware development, or navigating funding—so innovators can focus on what truly matters: their ideas and the products. We address the technological knowledge gap between doctors and developers, streamlining the entire process from concept to market. Our mission is to break down these barriers and empowerhealthcare professionals to bring their ideas to life, solving real-world problems with real-world solutions.

We bridge the gap in MedTech innovation, HardTech development, and the supportsystem for healthcare innovators. Biolaunchpad is the trusted partner to transform challenges into breakthroughs.

## What We Are Trying to Solve for Healthcare Professionals

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6762742043ac7f2dae7d92a6_What%20We%20Are%20Trying%20to%20Solve%20for%20Healthcare%20Professionals.png)

In recent years, there has been a surge in entrepreneurial spirit among doctors and healthcare professionals. Many are dissatisfied with their current roles, feeling either burned out or missing out on an alternative career path besides clinical practice.

Unlike professionals in other fields, healthcare experts often find themselves disconnected from the world of technology and product development. They lack the technical know-how and confidence to bring their ideas to life, hindering innovation in the healthcare sector.

Compounding this challenge is the immense pressure on healthcare professionals to maintain their medical practice. Balancing the demands of running a company with a successful clinical practice is often difficult, if not impossible. The significant time and effort required for MedTech product development make it challenging for many to step away from their clinical responsibilities to pursue entrepreneurship full-time.

This is where Biolaunchpad steps in! We understand these unique challenges, and we’re here to be the trusted business partner for healthcare innovators. We select smart, driven individuals with exceptional ideas and work with them to turn those ideas into reality. By partnering with us, healthcare professionals can stay focused on their practice while we handle the complexities of product development, funding, and scaling their innovations. Our goal is to make MedTech entrepreneurship accessible and achievable for the healthcare community, removing the barriers that have held them back for too long.

# FAQs

## What is Biolaunchpad?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Biolaunchpad is India’s first crowdsourced MedTech innovation platform that partners with healthcare professionals to develop and commercialize HealthTech solutions. We don’t just provide guidance; we co-develop innovative ideas, working alongside you to create breakthrough products that solve real-world healthcare challenges.

## How is Biolaunchpad different from an incubator or accelerator?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Biolaunchpad is a venture studio that does more than just mentor or fund. We actively co-develop MedTech ideas, becoming your partner in building, scaling, and commercializing your innovation. Unlike incubators or accelerators, we’re in the game with you, offering unmatched collaboration to bring your vision to life.

## Who can submit ideas to Biolaunchpad?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Doctors, surgeons, physiotherapists, dentists, nurses, and other healthcare professionals are welcome to share their MedTech ideas. We also invite anyone passionate about HealthTech innovation—regardless of their education, profession, or experience—to collaborate with us.

## Can someone other than healthcare professionals apply?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Yes! Engineers, entrepreneurs, designers, and anyone with a great HealthTech idea can work with Biolaunchpad. If you’re driven to create impactful healthcare solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

## What types of other services does Biolaunchpad offer?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Biolaunchpad offers a wide range of services, including:

- Company registration and compliance
- Legal agreements and documentation
- Ideation and validation support
- Market research
- Intellectual property management
- Funding assistance and opportunities

Our goal is to provide end-to-end support so you can focus on innovation.

## How does Biolaunchpad assess ideas?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

We assess ideas based on feasibility, market potential, and alignment with our mission. If your idea shows promise, we partner with you and co-develop the product together. We’re not just here to support—we’re here to build with you.

## Does Biolaunchpad focus on specific types of technologies?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

We are primarily focused on HealthTech and are particularly keen on supporting complex HardTech and hardware-based innovations. However, we are not limited to these and also support ideas in medical software (SaMD), AI, robotics, wearable technology, digital therapeutics, and more. If your idea has the potential to address real-world healthcare problems, we’re ready to collaborate.

## Where is Biolaunchpad located?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Biolaunchpad is headquartered in Pune, India, a growing hub for MedTech innovation with access to a strong talent pool and industry expertise.

## Does Biolaunchpad take equity in the ideas it supports?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Yes, Biolaunchpad operates as a co-developer and business partner. Equity terms depend on the project, but we ensure all partnerships are transparent, fair, and mutually beneficial.

## How can I submit my idea to Biolaunchpad?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

You can submit your idea through our website at [www.biolaunchpad.com/apply-now](https://www.biolaunchpad.com/apply-now). Simply fill out the form, and our team will review your concept for the next steps.

## Does Biolaunchpad help with regulatory compliance?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Yes, we provide comprehensive regulatory support, helping you navigate compliance requirements and secure necessary certifications to bring your product to market.

## Can international professionals collaborate with Biolaunchpad?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

Absolutely! Biolaunchpad welcomes collaborations with innovators and investors from around the world. If you’re passionate about transforming healthcare, we’re ready to partner with you.

## How can I connect with the Biolaunchpad team?

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/67627dae0c19f7ed23aed68d_arrow-circle-down.svg)

You can reach us at [biolaunchpad@gmail.com](mailto:biolaunchpad@gmail.com) for queries, discussions, or collaboration opportunities.

[![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/66eabf3a2812f4c50d947bf2_Biolounchpad-logo1%201.avif)](https://biolaunchpad.com/)

# How It Works

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6745c51e7c34777bf87c7d72_Idea%20Submission.svg)

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6715fbacd891ee71cffae6ae_Idea%20Submission.svg)

1

##### Idea Submission

We invite healthcare professionals, including doctors, surgeons, physiotherapists, nurses, and others, to submit innovative ideas for medical devices, healthcare software, diagnostics, or other technologies that address real-world healthcare challenges.

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6715fbac1d464cb83a2bc3a9_Initial%20Assessment.svg)

2

##### Initial Assessment

Once submitted, ideas are rigorously evaluated by our expert team. We assess feasibility, market potential, and problem-solving capabilities through technical reviews, competitive analysis, and initial market research. The goal is to identify ideas with clear paths to development and commercial success.

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6745c51ed14f1c68c8a8fc83_Initial%20Assessment%20%C2%A0.svg)

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6745c51ea898459b8c0ed783_Partnership%20and%20Strategy%20Development.svg)

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6715fbac809c171b160c3a42_Partnership%20and%20Strategy%20Development.svg)

3

##### Partnership and Strategy Development

We collaborate closely with innovators to bring their ideas to life. Our comprehensive support includes:

- Designing and prototyping cutting-edge products
- Navigating complex regulatory landscapes
- Securing funding and resources
- Developing robust business strategies

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6715fbac97866e3c25d882e6_Development%20and%20Testing.svg)

4

##### Development and Testing

We transition to the development phase, where we handle hardware or software development while keeping the innovator actively involved. This phase involves:

- Prototyping and iteration to refine the prototype and meet specific requirements
- Rigorous testing, clinical trials, and validation to ensure safety, effectiveness, and readiness of product.

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6745c51e125228519aa9eb27_Development%20and%20Testing%20%C2%A0.svg)

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6745c51ff0e1285e73bc6250_Regulatory%20Approval.svg)

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6715fbade0496a327590c37a_Regulatory%20Approval.svg)

5

##### Regulatory Approval

We are experts in navigating the complex regulatory landscape for MedTech products, right from required certifications and, approvals to legal and regulatory documentation. Our team ensures smooth approval processes and timely market entry.

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6715fbac5c5d9f9e11564ce9_Manufacturing%20and%20Scale-Up.svg)

6

##### Manufacturing and Scale-Up

We manage the manufacturing phase, from selecting manufacturers to scaling production. Our goal is a seamless transition to full-scale production, maintaining quality and cost-efficiency.

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6745c51ec1e093754e05f6c6_Manufacturing%20and%20Scale-Up%20%C2%A0.svg)

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6745c51ea656864293b02188_Go-to-Market%20Strategy.svg)

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6715fbac94e7b4b6c288ae45_Go-to-Market%20Strategy.svg)

7

##### Go-to-Market Strategy

With the product ready, we execute a robust go-to-market strategy. This includes:

- Establishing effective sales and distribution channels
- Developing and executing targeted marketing and branding initiatives
- Providing ongoing post-market support and product improvement

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6715fbac94e7b4b6c288ae1a_Exit%20or%20Growth.svg)

8

##### Exit or Growth

Depending on the innovator's strategic objectives, we support either a strategic exit, such as merger & acquisition (M&A) by a larger company, or continued growth and expansion. For those seeking sustained growth, we provide comprehensive support in long-term business planning, additional funding rounds, and expansion into new markets.

![](https://biolaunchpad.com/assets/cdn.prod.website-files.com/66e28aa7fe98f777d60cc2af/6745c51eb3ae61dab8f69ff8_Exit%20or%20Growth%20%C2%A0.svg)
